column3: One metadata-only event per completed transaction or savepoint from SQLAlchemy Connection events (begin/commit/rollback/savepoint; TransactionRecorder.java, TransactionPayload.java), never SQL text, parameters or URL; method is the application frame that began it (BootUI's @Transactional method has no Python twin); readOnly only from the postgresql_readonly execution option and isolation only from the isolation_level execution option; rollbackOnly false, failureClass null, ormStatements/ormFlushes/ormDirtyEntities -1 (no W5b orm source yet); a close with no commit is completion CLOSE and rolledBack false; not ported: the RuntimeEvent fields executionId, threadKind and failedOrSlow; extra field completion
